MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNNEEDEDGOODCHILD.desc: Strengthen the next Ember this turn: deal 1 damage a number of times equal to the burned card's cost. If its cost is greater than 3 and it has Ember, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. You may right-click a candidate to increase its cost by 1 for this use.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.title: Two Separated Ends
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.descr: Your Ember: if you choose the original card, gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you choose the linked card, draw {Cards:diff()} card and reduce its cost by 1 for this use.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BEFOREFORGIVEN.title: Before Forgiveness
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BEFOREFORGIVEN.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this burns a card, deal {BurnDamage:diff()} more damage. If it burns a card costing more than 2, return it to your hand with its cost reduced by 1 for this use.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.title: Hug Through Glass
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If this card is burned, return it to your hand at the start of next turn, set its cost to 0, and gain Block equal to this card's Block.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_STAYINGSTILLHURTS.desc: Burn 1 card in your hand. If it has Ember, randomly trigger the choice from 1 Ember card among all cards and reduce its cost by {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} for this use. Otherwise, draw 1 card.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_STAYINGSTILLHURTS.sele: Choose 1 card in your hand to burn
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.title: Don't Bring Me Home
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Choose 1 card in your hand to gain Ember and Retain. At end of turn, if it is still in your hand, burn it. Next turn, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.select: Choose 1 card in your hand to gain Ember and Retain
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WARMTHSHOULDNOTSTAY.de: Whenever you play a card with Ember, a random card among all cards without Ember gains Ember.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDECHO.title: Burned Echo
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDECHO.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. For each card burned by Ember this turn, this card deals +{BurnBonus:diff()} damage. After it is played, its cost increases by 1 until the start of next turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.title: Fifth Self-Proof
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.descrip: Deal 1 damage a number of times equal to this card's count. Every 5 completed manual Ember choices, this card gains 1 count. When using Ember, you may spend count to right-click strengthen a candidate: Attack +1 hit; Skill is played 1 extra time if chosen and played; Power creates a random Power card with cost -1 and Ember. Current count: {FireCount:diff()}.

ManosabaLin.YalisalinFireComponent.selec: Choose 1 card to play; burn the other

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_REVERSECALCULATION.des: Cool the target's earliest Fire Color by 1 segment. Gain sealed fire of the color before cooling. {IfUpgraded:show:Consume 1 additional Fire Color segment. |}Heat Up.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWODIFFERENTTESTIMONIE: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times. After each hit, consume 1 Fire Color segment. If this card consumes two different colors in a row, resolve the later color's consume reward 1 extra time.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNUSEDCONCLUSION.title: Unused Conclusion
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNUSEDCONCLUSION.descr: Each turn, the first time you consume different Fire Colors consecutively, gain sealed fire of the later color and draw 1 card.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNSEENKINDLING.title: Unseen Kindling
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNSEENKINDLING.descrip: Choose an enemy. If it has no Fire Color, give it 2 Fire Color segments. If it has Fire Color, give it 1 segment and draw {Cards:diff()} card. Heat Up. {IfUpgraded:show:Gain {Block:diff()} Block.|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_AFTERSCHOOLTESTBURN.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Consume 1 Fire Color segment. If the target still has Fire Color, cool 1 segment and resolve that color's consume reward 1 extra time.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASHINPAGES.title: Ash Between Pages
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASHINPAGES.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you have sealed fire, copy 1 sealed fire. Otherwise, gain sealed fire of the target's earliest Fire Color.
Lose {Life:diff()} HP. Give the target Fire Color until full. If it was already full, consume {Consume:diff()} Fire Color segments instead. Force Heat Up.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTCOOLDOWN.title: Don't Cool Down
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTCOOLDOWN.descripti: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Preserve Highest Fire Color. When you would consume the highest Fire Color, you may consume 2 lower Fire Color segments instead. The first time this rewrites a consume each turn, gain 1 Energy.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GRAZINGCRITICAL.title: Grazing Critical
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GRAZINGCRITICAL.descri: Consume 1 Fire Color segment. If this makes the target leave full Fire Color, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and give it 1 Fire Color segment. Heat Up; if the target becomes full again, Force Heat Up instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DEADLINEHANDOFF.title: Deadline Handoff
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DEADLINEHANDOFF.descri: Repeat {Repeats:diff()} times: if the target is not full, deal {Damage:diff()} damage and Force Heat Up once; if it is full, consume {Consume:diff()} Fire Color segments. Heat Up.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.title: Temperature Proof
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Cool 1 Fire Color segment, then consume 1 Fire Color segment. If the two involved colors differ, give 1 Fire Color segment. If this card makes the target enter or leave full Fire Color, Heat Up becomes Force Heat Up. Draw {Cards:diff()} card. {IfUpgraded:show:Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TICKETONWINDOW.title: Ticket on the Window
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TICKETONWINDOW.descrip: Each turn, the first time a target's Fire Color is filled to full, gain 1 Preserve Highest Fire Color.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.title: Same Wrong Problem
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the last Fire Color you consumed this turn differs from the target's earliest Fire Color, consume the target's earliest Fire Color segment. Otherwise, cool the target's earliest Fire Color segment and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.title: Tomorrow's Burn
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.descripti: Gain {Preserve:diff()} Preserve Highest Fire Color. Repeat {Repeats:diff()} times: consume 1 Fire Color segment. Each time Preserve Highest Fire Color rewrites the consume, draw {Cards:diff()} card and gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. Heat Up.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THIRTEENTHLISTENER.des: Each turn, the first time you use sealed fire to cover Fire Color, if the target is full, gain 1 Preserve Highest Fire Color. Each turn, the first time Preserve Highest Fire Color rewrites a consume, gain sealed fire of the preserved color.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_POCKETMATCHBOX.title: Pocket Matchbox
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_POCKETMATCHBOX.descrip: Move the target's last Fire Color segment to the front. If that color differs from the last Fire Color you consumed this turn, draw {Cards:diff()} card. {IfUpgraded:show:Gain {Block:diff()} Block.|}
